title: Pitch New Tech Ideas: prize money per year
text: Every year from 2023 to 2026 Pitch New Tech Ideas selects a maximum of 3 winners, each awarded a cash prize of HK$1,200: prize money paid to the winners is at most 3 x HK$1,200 = HK$3,600. 'The Best Presenter' is a separate award, a cash prize of HK$1,000; only a question that counts the Best Presenter award too gets HK$4,600. Winning proposals can also get up to HK$100K of funding support (not a cash prize).
evidence: A maximum of 3 proposals will be selected as winners and awarded a cash prize of HK$1,200

title: 3D printers run by the Innovation Wing: all models
text: The Innovation Wing (the Centre) runs 7 3D printer models in total, listed on its two equipment pages: innowings equipment page: Bambu Lab P1S, Bambu Lab X1C and Bambu Lab H2D (3 FDM printers, PLA), Formlabs Form4 (SLA, resin) and MicroArch S240 (ultra-high resolution, 10 um); innoacademy equipment page: Ultimaker 3 Extended and Raise3D Pro2+. That is 3 Bambu Lab models, 5 FDM models in all (3 Bambu Lab, Ultimaker, Raise3D), 1 SLA printer, 1 ultra-high resolution printer. Largest build volume among the Bambu Lab printers: H2D, 350 x 320 x 325 mm (P1S and X1C: 256 x 256 x 256 mm).

title: Innovation Wing venues: floor area and seats (venue page)
text: Venues for events, net usable area: Makerspace assembling area 1: 153 square metres, 10 workbenches with 6 seats each (60 seats). Makerspace assembling area 2: 130 square metres, 5 workbenches with 6 seats each (30 seats). Areas 1 and 2 together: 283 square metres, 15 workbenches, 90 seats. Open event area (LG/F): 66 square metres, 6 free tables by default. Event Hall A: 93 square metres; Event Hall B: 93 square metres; together 186 square metres; each hall seats at most 60 in a seminar setting (120 for both). Digital Learning Studio: 55 square metres, 29 computers with CAD software and 1 teacher desk with computer. Largest venue: Makerspace assembling area 1 (153); smallest: Digital Learning Studio (55). The open event area is 11 square metres larger than the Digital Learning Studio. Note: the innowings equipment page instead says the Digital Learning Studio has 20 high performance computers including the instructor's.

title: Innovation Wing opening hours per week, and staff on duty
text: Opening hours for members (innowings membership page): Monday to Friday 9:00am to 9:00pm (12 hours a day, 60 hours), Saturday 9:00am to 1:00pm (4 hours): 64 hours a week; closed on Sunday and university/public holidays. The innoacademy membership page gives older hours: Monday to Friday 9:30am to 9:00pm, Saturday 9:30am to 5:00pm (65 hours a week). In most opening hours 5 tutors and 4 technicians are on duty: 9 staff in total.
